**Build passes now.** The bump broke two link-stage call sites.

`[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. That threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`.

`[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on `undefined`. The new loader leaves unset flags unset. It now defaults to `false`.

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations, not noise. Things like `DEP0198 Buffer()` in `src/legacy/`. Those files are not in this tree.

Next: get the `src/legacy/` files to clear the `DEP` warnings.
